title: Lucrative
summary: LU'CRATIVE, adjective [Latin lucrativus, from lucror, to gain profit.] Gainful; profitable; making increase of money or goods; as a lucrative trade; lucrative business or office.

inlines.v: LU'CRATIVE, adjective [Latin lucrativus, from lucror, to gain profit.] Gainful; profitable; making increase of money or goods; as a lucrative trade; lucrative business or office.
